The NGBT spectrum

Nine designs for running node graphs and behavior trees on one device, simulated side by side; #396, detached nodes, is the one chosen. Four are shown: #407 (#396 as main runs it), #409 (#407 with every node a full tree node), #404 and #405. The Designs menu at the top right shows the others. Each tab ticks the same example with that design's rules; the meters count what it does. The overview’s benchmarks run the same workloads in three harnesses (this page’s model, Rust natively, and Rust compiled to wasm in this browser), among them two realistic ones: a robot face, and a robot in conversation.
